basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming TIC (Tenancy in Common) in San Francisco's Inner Sunset Districtjust steps from Golden Gate Park, Irving Street shops, SFSU, and public transit. Morning and evening tech shuttle stops are within a 2-minute walkperfect for Peninsula commuters.    Inside, enjoy a bright open layout with light-washed hardwood floors and a modern kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, subway tile backsplash, and an eat-in counter ideal for dining or entertaining. The spacious bedroom offers a walk-in closet, and the bonus flex space is perfect for a home office or creative retreat.    A sleek bathroom, assigned parking, private storage unit, and shared laundry round out the comforts of this well-maintained home. With a low HOA of just $150/month and owner financing available with at least $100K down, this is an excellent opportunity to own in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.    Schedule your showing today!
